item.description:
Water that stays. A wiper when you want it.

  • Small rain beads remain on the glass. Water no longer fades away on an expiry timer; it merges, grows heavier and can drain off the lower edge.
  • Press Control–Option–Command–W for one smooth beam-wiper sweep. The blade gathers water at its edge while rain keeps falling.
  • Choose your own combination under A few little details → Wiper shortcut, or use Wipe glass there. Escape cancels recording; shortcut conflicts keep your previous choice.
  • Quiet stereo rubber strokes follow the wiper. Sound off silences them along with rain.
  • The accepted rain approach, clear photographs and snow behavior are preserved.

Your existing settings and imported photographs are preserved. No additional app or subscription is needed.

Rain on the glass above you

  • Rain now feels like looking up through a roof window. Round drops approach a point on the glass, strike it, briefly spread and leave a water bead.
  • Intensity controls how often drops arrive. It no longer thickens or stretches the falling drops.
  • Live glass contacts trigger soft, varied taps, panned toward where they land. The sound toggle and volume apply to both ambience and taps.
  • Water gathers and joins nearby beads, with only slow drainage. Photographs remain visible.
  • Snow retains its existing movement, flakes, frost and ambience.

Your settings and imported photographs are preserved.

A clearer street, more visible rain

  • Fixes the excessive blur that hid Istanbul photographs when rain started. Softness now keeps the scene recognizable, including with your saved settings. Rain no longer adds a blue tint.
  • Rain is drawn separately from photo softness, so droplets stay visible. Intensity now changes their width, contrast and number while preserving slow movement.
  • More clearly sized water beads collect on the glass. Raising intensity during a session adds water gradually without resetting the pattern.
  • New image checks cover photograph colours, fine detail, Retina rendering and the difference between light and heavy rain.

Your settings and imported photographs are preserved.
